title: Smiling Toddler Crouching, Backyard Lawn - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot capturing a happy toddler crouching on a sunny grass lawn in a residential backyard. The child wears a light-colored collared shirt, shorts, and shoes with socks, smiling broadly under direct sunlight. In the background stands a wooden lattice screen adjacent to an outbuilding or house, surrounded by lush shrubs, utility lines, and a garden hose running along the concrete border in the foreground. The reverse side is covered with heavy black paper residue from having been previously mounted in an album.
